text:
The fix is straightforward. The original code only replaced non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens but didn't collapse consecutive hyphens or strip leading/trailing ones. I added two lines:

1. `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` — collapses multiple consecutive hyphens into a single hyphen.
2. `text.strip("-")` — removes any leading or trailing hyphens.

This ensures `slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello-world"` and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"`.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by adding two post-processing steps: collapsing consecutive hyphens with `re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)` and stripping leading/trailing hyphens with `text.strip("-")`. This resolves the issue of double hyphens and trailing hyphens in the output.
